features.description: Raw transaction amount in USD
features.mathematical_formula: T_i.amount
features.name: amount

features.description: Natural logarithm of (1 + amount)
features.mathematical_formula: ln(1.0 + T_i.amount)
features.name: log_amount

features.description: Hour of transaction in UTC (0..23)
features.mathematical_formula: T_i.timestamp.hour
features.name: hour_of_day

features.description: Day of week (0=Monday, 6=Sunday)
features.mathematical_formula: T_i.timestamp.weekday()
features.name: day_of_week

features.description: Binary flag for Saturday/Sunday (1 if weekday >= 5 else 0)
features.mathematical_formula: 1 if T_i.timestamp.weekday() >= 5 else 0
features.name: is_weekend

features.causal_boundary: Current event T_i + Customer creation time
features.description: Haversine distance between customer home and transaction coordinates
features.mathematical_formula: haversine(C.home_lat, C.home_lon, T_i.lat, T_i.lon)
features.name: dist_from_home_km

features.description: Haversine distance from previous customer transaction in causal order
features.mathematical_formula: haversine(T_prev.lat, T_prev.lon, T_i.lat, T_i.lon) if T_prev exists else 0.0
features.name: dist_from_prev_txn_km

features.description: Elapsed seconds since previous customer transaction in causal order
features.mathematical_formula: (T_i.timestamp - T_prev.timestamp).total_seconds() if T_prev exists else -1.0
features.name: time_since_prev_txn_seconds

features.description: Implied travel speed in km/h from previous transaction
features.mathematical_formula: (dist_from_prev_txn_km / (time_since_prev_txn_seconds / 3600.0)) if time > 0 else 0.0
features.name: speed_kmh
features.state_required: Customer previous transaction location and timestamp

features.description: Count of customer transactions in trailing 1h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: | { T_j in C | T_j < T_i and (t_i - 3600s) <= t_j <= t_i } |
features.name: cust_velocity_1h_count

features.description: Sum of customer transaction amounts in trailing 1h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: sum( T_j.amount for T_j in C where T_j < T_i and (t_i - 3600s) <= t_j <= t_i )
features.name: cust_velocity_1h_sum
features.state_required: Customer event amount queue for trailing 1h

features.description: Count of customer transactions in trailing 6h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: | { T_j in C | T_j < T_i and (t_i - 21600s) <= t_j <= t_i } |
features.name: cust_velocity_6h_count

features.description: Sum of customer transaction amounts in trailing 6h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: sum( T_j.amount for T_j in C where T_j < T_i and (t_i - 21600s) <= t_j <= t_i )
features.name: cust_velocity_6h_sum
features.state_required: Customer event amount queue for trailing 6h

features.description: Count of customer transactions in trailing 24h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: | { T_j in C | T_j < T_i and (t_i - 86400s) <= t_j <= t_i } |
features.name: cust_velocity_24h_count

features.description: Sum of customer transaction amounts in trailing 24h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: sum( T_j.amount for T_j in C where T_j < T_i and (t_i - 86400s) <= t_j <= t_i )
features.name: cust_velocity_24h_sum
features.state_required: Customer event amount queue for trailing 24h

features.description: Count of merchant transactions in trailing 1h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: | { T_j in M | T_j < T_i and (t_i - 3600s) <= t_j <= t_i } |
features.name: merch_velocity_1h_count

features.description: Count of merchant transactions in trailing 24h window strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: | { T_j in M | T_j < T_i and (t_i - 86400s) <= t_j <= t_i } |
features.name: merch_velocity_24h_count

features.description: Cumulative average amount of all customer transactions strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: mean( T_j.amount for T_j in C where T_j < T_i ) if history exists else T_i.amount
features.name: cust_avg_amount_hist
features.state_required: Customer cumulative amount sum and count strictly prior to T_i

features.description: Ratio of current amount to customer historical average amount
features.mathematical_formula: T_i.amount / cust_avg_amount_hist
features.name: cust_amount_to_avg_ratio
features.state_required: Customer historical mean amount strictly prior to T_i

features.description: Fraction of customer credit limit utilized at event time
features.mathematical_formula: T_i.balance_before / C.credit_limit
features.name: balance_utilization

features.description: Binary flag (1 if customer has never used this device_id prior to T_i, else 0)
features.mathematical_formula: 1 if device_id not in C.known_devices_prior_to_t else 0
features.name: is_new_device
features.state_required: Set of devices used by customer strictly prior to T_i

features.description: Count of distinct customers who used this device strictly prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: | { T_j.customer_id | T_j.device_id == T_i.device_id and T_j < T_i } |
features.name: device_cust_count
features.state_required: Set of customers per device strictly prior to T_i

features.description: Number of failed authentication attempts reported on current transaction
features.mathematical_formula: T_i.auth_failed_count
features.name: auth_failed_count

features.description: Binary flag: 1 if payment was initiated by an autonomous agent, else 0
features.mathematical_formula: 1 if T_i.agent_id is not None else 0
features.name: is_agent_initiated

features.description: Historical fraud rate at this merchant using only labels confirmed >= 7 days prior to T_i
features.mathematical_formula: sum(T_j.is_fraud for T_j in M where t_j <= t_i - 7d) / count(T_j for T_j in M where t_j <= t_i - 7d) if count > 0 else 0.0
features.name: merch_fraud_rate_7d_lag
features.state_required: Confirmed fraud labels per merchant strictly older than 7 days (604,800s)
